sentence: This project studies how to reduce the rise in microvascular permeability that makes outcomes of traumatic injury worse.
This project builds small molecules attached to polymeric biomaterial surfaces that interfere with nucleotide signaling and stop biofilm bacteria from forming and growing.
This project builds an integrated database and makes sure that study design, data checking and statistical analysis are done properly for all its studies.
This project studies how immune imprinting shapes antibody responses to avian influenza vaccines and looks for antigen designs that overcome imprinting.
This project studies how different groups of neurons in the parafascicular thalamus control movement and motor learning, using a mouse model of Parkinson's disease.
This project studies how neural circuits produce decision-making and how environmental contexts change brain network configurations to allow behavioral flexibility.
This project tries to find genes and variants that cause tooth agenesis and studies how their dysregulation changes gene and protein function.
This project studies how cells move within the palatal mesenchyme while the secondary palate forms in mammalian craniofacial development.
This project continues a course and a global community of practice that helps clinicians use cancer genomics in cancer risk assessment and treatment.
This project studies how epithelial cells activate fibroblasts in fibrotic lung diseases, looking for a target to prevent or treat fibrosis of the lung.
This project builds personalized imaging measures based on brain landmarks from neuroimaging datasets to improve early diagnosis and prediction of Alzheimer's disease.
This project builds a processor and software that analyze brain signals in a brain implantable neuromodulation device for epilepsy.
This project studies how HIV strains resist broadly neutralizing antibodies and looks for indirect pathways that the virus may use to escape them.
This project studies migraine and affective disorders during hormonal fluctuations, using smartphone data collected from people who have migraine.
This project studies how gut microbiota and their metabolites affect seizure occurrence and neuronal physiology in epilepsy.
This project combines machine learning with large datasets to predict and design how T cell receptors recognize tumor antigens.
This project builds drugs that target the Nef protein of HIV so that immune cells can find and kill infected cells.
This project combines structural biology and biophysics with cellular neuroscience techniques to test how neurotransmitter receptor organization controls synaptic strength.
This project studies how stress affects the brain, mind and body in a diverse sample and how these changes relate to adverse health outcomes.
This project builds and tests therapies for solid tumors and hematologic malignancies, moving preclinical discoveries toward early-stage clinical testing.
